# Archived upstream automation

These workflows are retained for reference and attribution. GitHub Actions
only discovers workflow YAML directly under `.github/workflows/`; files in
this subdirectory do not run. Desktop/mobile/store releases, upstream image
publishing and old whole-product CI are disabled for this server-only fork.
The active `../ci.yml` builds and tests VoiceStudio Online. CLA, commit identity
and security checks remain active in the parent directory. No release or
updater asset has been changed.
